description: This file defines a syntax highlighting mode for Swift language in the CodeMirror code editor, including tokenization rules, keywords, and parsing logic.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Represents parsing context with previous context, alignment, and indentation.

methods.name: wordSet
methods.description: Creates a set object from an array of words for quick lookup.

methods.name: tokenBase
methods.description: Performs tokenization of the code stream based on syntax rules.

methods.name: tokenUntilClosingParen
methods.description: Handles tokenization until a closing parenthesis is found, managing nested parentheses.

methods.name: tokenString
methods.description: Handles string tokenization, including escape sequences and embedded expressions.

methods.name: pushContext
methods.description: Pushes a new parsing context onto the context stack.

methods.name: popContext
methods.description: Pops the current parsing context from the context stack.
